reason: Both answers correctly identify the main threats to causal inference and propose strong staggered-rollout designs. A is slightly better because it more clearly separates distinct problems, gives a more complete and operational design (including an explicit count model with exposure offsets), and more systematically addresses pre-trends, regression to the mean, rare outcomes, spillovers, heterogeneity, and concurrent interventions. B is also sound and well reasoned, but somewhat less complete in its implementation details.
